thread:
Samir: FYI seeing Python SDK generator hang after yesterday's edge rollout. Started ~10:02am UTC.
Nicole: Can you paste logs + SDK version?
Samir: SDK v0.7.1. Repro script: `python examples/stream_chat.py --model redwood-2-small --stream` — it streams a few tokens then stops and generator never yields again. No exception.
Ash: Any network drop/reconnects? server side released a keepalive change last night.
Samir: No network drop. Curl to /v1/stream returns a steady SSE keepalive every 15s but payload shape changed: used to be `:\n\n` heartbeats, now server emits `event: keepalive\ndata: \n\n`. Python client appears to buffer mid-event and never sees end-of-event.
Nicole: Paste minimal logs (enable DEBUG).
Samir: ```
recv: b"data: {\"delta\": \"hel"
recv: b"lo\n\n"
# after that no further recv, generator hangs in `_iter_sse` waiting for another chunk
```
Jen: Looks like split token where the SSE event delimiter `\n\n` crosses a boundary. Parser expects delimiter-only heartbeats and treats `event:` lines differently.
Samir: Workaround I used: downgraded to v0.6.9 and it continues to stream (old server format). But customers on v0.7.x hit this.
support-bot: Ticket created: 2026-03-15T10:20:00Z #INC-4823 (escalate to eng-ml).
Nicole: Could be a strict check in sse.py that treats lines starting with `event:` as non-terminal. Our code waits for a blank line after an `event:` block but if `data:` is empty it still closes — bug when `data:` split across recv.
Ash: I can repro locally by injecting `event: keepalive\ndata:\n\n` across two recv calls. Repro script attached.
Samir: Minimal repro: ```python
from redwood import StreamClient
cli = StreamClient(api_key='redacted')
d = b'event: keepalive\ndata:'
# send first chunk, then ' b' '' 
```
Nicole: Hotfix options: 1) server revert to old heartbeat format (quick) 2) patch Python SSE parser to be tolerant of empty `data:` lines and treat `event:`/`data:` sequences as part of same event until delimiter `\n\n` seen even if split (safer) 3) release client v0.7.2 with defensive buffering.
Jen: I pushed a small patch to `sse.py` to accumulate until delimiter regardless of intermediate `event:` lines and added regression tests for split boundaries. PR #2147.
devx-bot: CI passed for PR #2147 on Python 3.9/3.10, added test `test_split_keepalive_boundary`.
Nicole: Can we cut a 0.7.3 patch with this fix? Customers on v0.7.x experiencing stalls.
Ash: I'll run integration against canary server and simulate rotation + keepalive format.
Samir: Integration run looks good for me — no hang after 2k events.
Nicole: 0.7.3 release drafted. Notes: fixes SSE split-boundary hang for keepalive/event pairs; recommends customers upgrade.
Samir: Thx — verified upgrade to 0.7.3 in our staging app and streaming resumed.
Jen: Added changelog and bump in setup.cfg. Please watch for any perf regressions.
Nicole: Closing thread when 0.7.3 is published to pip and support informs affected customers. :thumbsup:
Samir: Confirmed pip publish succeeded and stage app green. Closing on our side.
